notes.title: Chinese is now supported!
notes.content:
* Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) is now supported.

* Fixed a problem in which Gamepad would sometimes stop working when returning to the game screen after switching to a different window or other active window from the game when using Gamepad.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.
